About Us

Landscaping in Godalming

On time, done properly, and left better than I found it.

I'm Freddy, born and raised in Surrey. I run The Greensman from Elstead and have been trading since 2024. I lay patios and paths, put up fences and decking, renovate tired gardens and lay new lawns. I still look after gardens week to week too.

You deal with me from start to finish.

Fully insured. Fixed written quotes. Free visit, no call-out fee, and a written guarantee on every job.

The Process

How a Job Works

  1. Site visitI come out, walk the garden with you and measure up. Then I send you a written quote with everything listed. The price is fixed.
  2. Start dateWe agree a start date and I give you a plan of what happens each week. Materials are ordered and on site before I start.
  3. The workI keep you updated, tidy up at the end of every day, and you don't pay for a stage until you're happy with it.
  4. HandoverWe walk round it together when it's done. You get a written guarantee, and I can keep looking after the garden if you want.
